newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduras to import up to 40,000 46-kg bags coffee.
newsitem.headline: Honduras to import up to 40,000 46-kg bags coffee.

text.p: Honduras will import later in the year about 40,000 46-kg bags of coffee in 1997 for domestic consumption, an industry leaders said on Wednesday.

"It is necessary to import coffee to meet demand in the last two months of the year. A maximum of 40,000 46-kg bags is expected," Director of the Honduran Coffee Institute Fernando Montes told reporters.
This small Central American nation produces about three million 46-kg bags of coffee and consumes about 21,000 bags at subsidized prices.
Coffee experts have said the coffee reserved for domestic consumption is generally of lower quality. Montes said it will look for imports at a cost of about $100 per 46-kg bag.
"From the trade perspective it is better to export our coffee and import lower quality coffee and a price of $100," Montes said.
